fusions.name: Threading Throw
fusions.desc: Hurls a single link that deals 40 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Stitch Through
fusions.desc: Casts a link that deals 14 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 70% of that. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Long Cast
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Thin Seam
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%.
